An analysis of the columns in the SUPPORT2 dataset:

- `alb` (Albumin): Baseline lab value. -> AVAILABLE
- `pafi` (PaO2/FiO2 ratio): Baseline lab value. -> AVAILABLE
- `ca` (Calcium): Baseline lab value. -> AVAILABLE
- `dzclass` (Disease class): Baseline diagnosis classification. -> AVAILABLE
- `dnrday` (Day of DNR status): The day on which the DNR order was written. This is a post-admission event and is not known at the time of prediction. -> UNAVAILABLE (TIMING)
- `ph` (pH): Baseline lab value. -> AVAILABLE
- `adlsc` (ADL surrogate): Baseline functional status. -> AVAILABLE
- `diabetes` (Diabetes history): Baseline comorbidity. -> AVAILABLE
- `income` (Income): Baseline demographic. -> AVAILABLE
- `dzgroup` (Disease group): Baseline diagnosis. -> AVAILABLE
- `charges` (Hospital charges): Finalized only after discharge. -> UNAVAILABLE (TIMING)
- `meanbp` (Mean blood pressure): Baseline vital sign. -> AVAILABLE
- `scoma` (SUPPORT physiology score coma component): Baseline assessment. -> AVAILABLE
- `dementia` (Dementia history): Baseline comorbidity. -> AVAILABLE
- `surv6m` (6-month survival): Actual survival status at 6 months. This is a post-baseline outcome. -> UNAVAILABLE (TIMING)
